falsePositives.note: a false positive is a defect verdict of true where the plant-time ground truth for that seed says false

referenceIntegrityProbe.note: baselines.mjs hardcodes dangling-ref:false citing a missing reference-integrity rule; computeValidationIssues has one. This is whether it fires on the corpus's own planted dangling refs.

medianRule: entityCount and fileBytes medians use the corrected even-length rule (mean of the two middle values) and were re-derived from the same 200 seeds. oracleMsPerModel and heuristicMsPerModel are wall clocks from a session that cannot be re-timed, so their medians remain the pre-fix upper-middle value of 200; the difference is bounded by the gap between two adjacent order statistics.
